column2: To update the Conditioning Schedules, we use a SAP COISPI report variant that pulls in all acitve non-complete conditioning process orders.
Completed or locked process orders are not in the scope of this variant.
That data is shown on the "SAP Coispi report" sheet.
The data from that report is copy/paste into an Excel file
Once the old data is cleared and the new data has been pasted into the Main tab, a data refresh is ran to refresh all of the sheets in the workbook.
Each sheet is verified for accuracy at this point
A copy of that workbook has been embedded here>>>>>>>>>
Once verified, Smartsheet Data Shuttle is used to refresh all of the conditioning schedules in Smartsheet.
